crypto.title: Cryptography Track
crypto.subtitle: Encoding, Hashes & Classical Ciphers
crypto.description: Master data encoding, cryptographic hash algorithms, message digests, and encryption/decryption mechanisms.

module1.title: Cryptography Basics

objectives.label: Encode the word "Cyber" into Base64.

Decode the following Base64 string:
Q3liZXJSYW5nZQ==
Encode the word "Hello" into Hex.

Decode the following Hex string and submit the output as the flag:
57656c636f6d65

hints: Hint 1: Base64 converts 3 bytes of binary data into 4 ASCII printable characters (ending with '=' for padding).
Hint 2: Select 'Base64 Decode' for 'SGVsbG8=' in the Decoder Panel to get 'hello', then submit FLAG{hello}.

module2.title: Hash Basics

objectives.label:
Generate the MD5 hash of:
password

Generate the SHA1 hash of:
admin

Generate the SHA256 hash of:
security
Which hash algorithm produces a 32-character hexadecimal output? (Submit the name, e.g. SHA256)

hints: Hint 1: SHA256 outputs 256 bits = 32 bytes = 64 hexadecimal characters.
Hint 2: MD5 hash '5f4dcc3b5aa765d61d8327deb882cf99' corresponds to the common password 'password'. Submit FLAG{password_found}.

module3.title: Hash Calculator

objectives.label:

Cyber

Generate the SHA256 hash of:

Hint 2: For Objective 4, compute SHA256 for 'CryptoMaster2026' and submit FLAG{sha256_master_2026}.

module4.title: Encryption Basics

objectives.label:
Encode the word into Base64:
Security

Encode the word into Hex:
Hash

Encode the word into Binary (space separated):
Key

Generate the SHA256 hash of the following and submit it as the flag:
Cyber123

hints: Hint 1: Caesar Cipher shifts each alphabet letter forward by N positions.
Hint 2: Encrypting 'HELLO' with a Caesar shift of 3 produces 'KHOOR'. Submit FLAG{khoor}.

module5.title: Decryption Basics

objectives.label:
Step 1: Decode the following Base64 string:
SGFzaA==
Step 2: Convert the decoded word ("Hash") into Hex.
Step 3: Generate the SHA256 hash of the Hex output ("48617368").
Step 4: Decode this Base64 string to find the final flag: RkxBR3tDcnlwdG9fTWFzdGVyfQ==

hints: Hint 1: Decryption reverses encryption using the exact shift or key.
Hint 2: Decrypting 'KHOOR' with shift 3 restores 'HELLO'. Submit FLAG{hello}.
